title: God of War Laufey to launch in February 2027 and its sequel already announced
summary: Sony has confirmed the release date of God of War Laufey for February 2027 and has announced the next Kratos game that will continue the story.

title: Final Fantasy XIV reveals Evercold expansion, its new class and the date on Switch 2
summary: The Evercold expansion of Final Fantasy XIV will include a collaboration with Final Fantasy VII and a Viking class, and the MMO will arrive on Nintendo Switch 2 on August 4, 2026.

title: Baldur's Gate 3 receives a mod that adds third-person camera
summary: A community-created mod allows playing Baldur's Gate 3 with a third-person camera, improving the experience for Dragon Age players.

title: A mod allows traveling between the worlds of GTA 3, Vice City and San Andreas
summary: A modder has created portals that connect the first three Grand Theft Auto games, creating a playable multiverse.

title: Silent Hill f writers had to read between 100 and 200 books a year
summary: The producer of Silent Hill f has revealed that the writers were forced to read a massive number of books for the game's development.

title: Thick As Thieves ends official support but remains playable
summary: Warren Spector's game has stopped receiving support after two months, although the studio assures that it will continue to work.

title: Meccha Chameleon suffers malware attacks and hacked Discord, despite being the second most profitable on Steam in June
summary: Meccha Chameleon, the second highest-grossing game on Steam in June, has suffered a malware attack on its maps and the hacking of its Discord server.

title: Splatoon Raiders debuts a tactical tank mode and suffers a loading screen bug
summary: The game Splatoon Raiders has added a new mode inspired by Vampire Survivors, but it has been discovered that a secret on the loading screen can cause the game to close.

title: Apple TV+ releases Neuromancer trailer and announces its release date
summary: The series based on William Gibson's novel now has a trailer and release date on Apple TV+.

title: Marvel Tōkon open beta on PC presents serious problems
summary: The Marvel Tōkon open beta for PC has been criticized by players due to technical issues and PSN service outages.

title: Specialists criticize Christopher Nolan's adaptation of The Odyssey for omitting key themes
summary: Expert Emily Wilson has pointed out that Nolan's film tries to cover too much and leaves out essential elements of the epic poem.
